title: Policy and Charging Control signalling flows; Stage 3
tagline: SM Policy Association — signalling diagrams for session policy
summary: TS 29.513 provides Stage-3 signalling flow diagrams for Policy and Charging Control, including SM Policy Association Establishment and Modification. In the 29.512 story, it complements the SBI API spec with message-sequence views of the same SMF–PCF interactions.
whyItMatters: 29.512 defines the REST API contract; 29.513 shows the signalling choreography. Together they explain both the wire format and the ordered exchange during PDU session establishment.
